result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. One clear visual defect is present: a promotional badge on the pizza restaurant card reads "–0%", indicating a discount value of zero being rendered rather than the badge being hidden. Other elements (header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) appear consistent.

issues.description: The badge on the pizza restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section displays "–0%", a nonsensical zero-percent discount. This suggests the discount value is missing or zero but the badge template is still being rendered.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is null or 0, and add a guard so the badge only renders for discounts greater than 0%.
